item.title: Alex Pretti's Death Sparks Widespread Discourse Online Surrounding Use Of AI Imagery
item.description: The 2026 ICE Shooting of Alex Pretti refers to the fatal shooting of 37-year-old intensive care nurse Alex Pretti by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The shooting happened on January 24th, 2026, roughly two weeks after the fatal shooting of Renee Good by an ICE agent in the same city. item.title: Babies Imagined As YouTubers In Recent 'Bluesky' Meme Trend
item.description: Baby YouTube Thumbnails refers to a series of parody memes that imagine toddlers or infants as YouTube content creators. The thumbnails typically feature clickbait design choices alongside images of babies performing basic developmental activities and playing games for babies, such as peek-a-boo and blocks, with titles mimicking those of video essays. The memes were popularized in late January 2026 on sites including X / Twitter and Bluesky, where the trend was started by user lmaonadestand.

item.title: Kai Cenat Claims That 'Viva La Vida' Is By 'Cosplay,' Becoming A Big 'Performative Kai Cenat' Meme
item.description: Viva La Vida by Cosplay or Viva La Vidia by Cosplay is a series of memes based on a viral video of streamer Kai Cenat saying to an interview that he would describe his current outfit with the song "Viva La Vidia" by "cosplay," meaning "Viva La Vida" by Coldplay. The interview was uploaded by TikToker @deeswishnyc in October 2024 and resurfaced in January 2026 amid the virality of the performative Kai Cenat memes, inspiring edits and memes.

item.title: Newscaster 'Carissa Codel' Goes Viral For Reading Hate And Thirst Comments In Her News Voice
item.description: Carissa Codel is a newscaster on KOLR 10 and FOX 49 who is known online for her behind-the-scenes and vlog style content and a series of videos where she reads viewer hate and thirst comments in her newscaster voice. Many of the comments are compliments or insults about her figure, with some people online referring to her as the "thick newscaster."
